description: This file defines the implementation of a durable, serializable dictionary data structure for the Orleans framework, including interfaces, internal classes, and debugging views. It handles state recovery, logging, versioning, and command execution for a persistent dictionary used in stateful Orleans grains.

classes.name: DurableDictionary<K, V>
classes.description: Internal implementation of a durable, serializable dictionary supporting versioned command log application, snapshotting, and stream-based state storage for Orleans applications.

classes.name: IDurableDictionaryDebugView<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Debug view class for inspecting the contents of an IDurableDictionary during debugging sessions.

classes.name: DebugViewDictionaryItem<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Helper struct for presenting key-value pairs in debugging views.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the dictionary state, clearing items and setting new storage.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry to the dictionary to update its state according to the command encoded in the log entry.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Method stub for appending log entries; no implementation in this class.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: Serializes and writes a snapshot of the dictionary's current state.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the dictionary and appends a clear command to the log.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the dictionary.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the dictionary and records the removal in the log if successful.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new key-value pair, invoking appropriate callbacks and recording the add in the log.

methods.name: ContainsKey
methods.description: Checks if the given key exists.

methods.name: TryGetValue
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a value for a given key.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the dictionary entries to an array.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator over the key-value pairs.
